newsitem.title: UK: EURO VGO PRICES SLIP ON LITTLE BUYING INTEREST.
newsitem.headline: EURO VGO PRICES SLIP ON LITTLE BUYING INTEREST.

text.p: European vacuum gas oil prices fell sharply by mid-week with a close arbitrage window to the United States and with plenty of avails left on the market and little buying interest in Europe.

Traders said a major sold a 55,000-tonne cargo of high sulphur VGO loading this weekend to a trader at $115 fob, or $5 off its earlier offer price. The major still has a second similar-sized cargo loading in the second half of August, the traders added.
They assessed low sulphur VGO cargoes, of which at least three are on offer, around the $125/$126 fob mark compared with $136 last Friday.
"The market looks very weak, there's quite a few cargoes offered. I think we'll see more downside," a trader said.

"The market is terrible. The arb is shut to the United States and there's no buying interest there and European refiners have problems with the catalytic crackers and don't want to buy the stuff," a trader with a refiner said.
But a third trader said that with European buying interest at a low point, "the arb would have to work to the States".
